digest.component_or_area: DC transport backend conformance and member implementation
propositions: The DC transport crashes during writing passes with AttributeError on set_entity_property, which is one of twelve missing methods the reconciler core calls but the transport does not declare.

Seven of the twelve missing methods have call sites that swallow all exceptions, causing silent data loss (comments, links, parents, properties, assignee validation) rather than crashes, making 'no AttributeError' an insufficient acceptance criterion.

The TicketTransport protocol lacks @runtime_checkable decorator and does not declare the full set of members the core requires (21 members actually called, only 6 declared), allowing incomplete implementations to pass isinstance checks at construction time.

DC-specific portability issues exist: get_parent_map cannot copy Cloud's v3 cursor pagination (rejected with HTTP 400 on DC); set_parent must branch between sub-task and epic linking; set_reporter requires reading DC's name field instead of accountId, and _identity_of must be fixed to prevent infinite reporter mutations.

Reporter sync fails idempotence on DC: inbound_fields._identity_of reads only accountId, so DC reporters yield account_id=None, causing _diff_reporter to re-emit the reporter mutation on every pass even after successful writes.

Transport member implementations must log failures at WARNING level naming both the member and remote ID before exceptions propagate, since seven call sites swallow exceptions silently and would otherwise leave no observable trace of failures.
